_comment: CareConnect — inline IAM policy for the careconnect-agentcore-proxy Lambda's execution role. It lets the proxy Lambda call your deployed AgentCore runtime. In the console: Lambda > (proxy function) > Configuration > Permissions > click the execution role > Add permissions > Create inline policy > JSON tab > paste this > name it 'invoke-agentcore'. For production, replace "*" in Resource with your specific runtime ARN.
